questions.stem: Pointing to a photo, Anil said: 'His father is my father's only son.' The person in the photo is Anil's:
questions.explanation: TYPE 1 — self-referential. 'My father's only son' = Anil himself. So 'his father is Anil' → the person in the photo is Anil's son.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A woman introduces a man as 'the son of the brother of my mother'. The man is the woman's:
questions.explanation: TYPE 3 — chain relation. Mother's brother = maternal uncle. His son = cousin (specifically maternal cousin).
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: B is the brother of A. C is the father of A. D is the brother of C. E is the son of D. How is E related to A?
questions.explanation: TYPE 5 — family tree. C is A's father; D is C's brother → D is A's uncle. E is D's son → E is A's cousin.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a girl, Ravi said: 'She is the daughter of the only daughter of my mother.' The girl is Ravi's:
questions.explanation: TYPE 1 — mother's only daughter = Ravi's sister (assuming Ravi is male). The girl is his sister's daughter = niece.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: X's mother is the only daughter of Y's father. How is Y's father related to X?
questions.explanation: X's mother is Y's father's only daughter → Y's father is X's maternal grandfather.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: If A + B means A is the father of B; A − B means A is the sister of B; A × B means A is the wife of B; then what does P + Q × R mean?

options.option_text: P is the father of R
P is the father-in-law of R
P is the brother of R
P is the husband of R

questions.explanation: TYPE 4 — coded family. P + Q = P is father of Q. Q × R = Q is wife of R. So P's daughter (Q) is married to R → P is R's father-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A man introduces a woman as the wife of the grandson of his mother. How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: The man's mother's grandson is the man's own son (since the mother's child = man himself; his son = grandson of mother). The son's wife = daughter-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Sarita has no brother or sister. Her father's only son-in-law is called ______ by Sarita's mother.
questions.explanation: Sarita has no siblings → she is the only daughter → her father's only son-in-law is her husband. Sarita's mother calls her own son-in-law 'son-in-law'.
questions.subject: Reasoning
